description: Look up the twelve consequential actions in the Canadian privacy corpus v2026.12.0: the moments where an AI agent handling personal information can cause real legal harm (vendor onboarding, cross-border transfer, breach notification, automated decisions, trackers, disposal, portability, secondary use, biometrics, minors, model deployment, policy changes). Each row returns the statutory triggers in English and French with a citation status (in_force, pending_first_reading, pending_verification), the enforcement or guidance record IDs, what an agent may prepare, and what it must never do without a human signature. Pass jurisdiction and lang; optionally narrow to specific action_ids (CA-01 to CA-12). Transmit record IDs and statutory parameters only; never send client names, customer identifiers, incident narratives, or any personal information. Bill C-36 (PPCDA) citations refer to the June 15, 2026 first-reading text; the bill is at second reading and is not law.

action_ids.description: Narrow to specific action IDs, CA-01 to CA-12. Omit to list every action relevant to the jurisdiction.

lang.description: Response language for the flat citation and note fields; rows always carry both languages.

name: canadian_privacy_consequential_action_lookup_v1

corpus_version.description: Semantic version of the movahedi.ca statutory corpus this answer was drawn from, for example v2026.12.0. Pin it when citing; when it changes, re-read the affected resources and the change log at https://movahedi.ca/changelog/.

rows.description: Matching consequential actions in deterministic CA-01..CA-12 order.

allowed_agent_scope.description: What an agent may prepare (draft only, human signs).

citation_ids.description: Corpus record IDs for enforcement actions and guidance.

french_completeness_status.description: Review state of the French text.

id.description: Stable row ID, CA-01 to CA-12.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions this row is relevant for.

prohibited_agent_actions.description: What an agent must never do without a human signature.

code.description: Stable corpus code for the provision.

note.description: Plain-language note in the requested language.

status.description: in_force: law today. pending_first_reading: Bill C-36 first-reading text, not law. pending_verification: primary-source check still open.

title: Look up consequential privacy actions
